name: Premium Twin Room
description: Experience the perfect blend of comfort and luxury in our Premium Twin Room. This spacious accommodation features two premium twin beds, modern amenities, and elegant décor. Ideal for families or friends traveling together, the room offers ample space to relax and unwind. Enjoy the city views, premium bedding, and all the modern conveniences you need for a comfortable stay.
